description: This dataset holds 124 primary variables for 224 large dams and reservoirs in Australia with a capacity of at least 10 GL. It combines dam and reservoir features collated from the ANCOLD (Australian National Committee on Large Dams) database, reservoir yield and dam cost data supplied by public and private organisations, and at-site and catchment variables on climate, hydrology, location and terrain calculated by the authors. It supports the paper 'Dams, dam costs and damnable cost overruns' by Petheram and McMahon, whose supplementary material describes the variables, and is a single 357 KB XLSX file on Mendeley Data (version 1, March 2020) under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: coverage is national but limited to large dams, costs come from many owners with differing bases, and the variable definitions sit in the paper's supplement. Simulation uses: cost and yield relationships for capacity planning and optimisation of new storage. Related record: the USGS dam removal cost compilation (data-usgs-dam-removal-cost-estimates).
